title: Saved Wi-Fi network profiles
whyItMatters: Each XML profile holds a network name and its saved key. A new owner could reconnect to old networks or recover the shared password.
source: WLAN profile XMLs live under %PROGRAMDATA%/Microsoft/Wlansvc/Profiles/Interfaces; see https://passcape.com/windows_password_recovery_dpapi_decoder
notes: Keys inside the XML are DPAPI-protected. Needs elevation because the store is machine-wide. Counts profile files only; none are parsed.
